methodologies.name: Historical Integrity V1
methodologies.purpose: Preserve published research, ranking history, and locked prediction history as append-only records that cannot be silently rewritten.
known_limitations: Pre-Phase-1 legacy rows may not have complete integrity metadata.
Historical integrity preserves records; it does not by itself prove source provenance or point-in-time correctness.
methodologies.change_summary: Initial immutable publication/ranking/prediction baseline.

methodologies.name: Research Composer V2
methodologies.purpose: Compose structured company research, valuation scenarios, quality scores, and expected-return outputs from normalized company metrics and historical context.
known_limitations: Composer V2 can use fixed DCF assumptions and fallback growth assumptions when evidence is incomplete.
Expected-return horizons reuse scenario terminal values rather than independently projecting each horizon.
Valuation Engine V3 is being developed separately to address these limitations.
methodologies.change_summary: Current production research composition baseline.

methodologies.name: Historical Context V2 Provenance
methodologies.purpose: Build normalized company history, capital allocation, valuation history, peer context, and point-in-time context packs for research composition.
known_limitations: When explicit filing timestamps are unavailable, filing availability can fall back to 90-day annual or 50-day quarterly heuristics.
Context quality depends on retained provider history and configured peer availability.
methodologies.change_summary: Current normalized historical/peer context engine.

methodologies.name: Data Coverage V2
methodologies.purpose: Measure decision-readiness evidence coverage across fundamentals, balance sheet, history, market history, valuation, capital allocation, peers, industry evidence, consensus, and research structure.

output_contract.coverage_report: layer percentages, readiness percentage, missing-field list

known_limitations: Coverage measures presence/completeness, not whether every datum is economically correct.
Primary-source coverage is coarse until provenance quality is fully integrated.
methodologies.change_summary: Current decision-readiness coverage engine.

methodologies.name: Decision Ranking V1
methodologies.purpose: Rank published companies by readiness tier and decision attractiveness while keeping evidence confidence separate from investment merit.

assumptions.missing_components: omit from component score and reduce coverage; never substitute 50

known_limitations: Evidence Confidence currently does not yet incorporate Phase 2 provenance conflict/confidence directly.
Decision Score is a research-ranking construct, not an automatic buy/sell instruction.
methodologies.change_summary: Initial three-dimensional decision ranking methodology.

methodologies.name: Decision Readiness V1
methodologies.purpose: Gate company research into Building, Research Ready, and Decision Ready states using explicit evidence and component-coverage requirements.
known_limitations: Decision Ready means evidence-complete enough for comparison, not an investment recommendation.
Readiness depends on the current coverage methodology and should be versioned when those gates materially change.
methodologies.change_summary: Initial readiness gating methodology.

methodologies.name: Evidence Provenance V1
methodologies.purpose: Preserve source documents, observations, canonical fact lineage, conflict state, knowledge time, and exact published research input provenance without rewriting prior evidence.
known_limitations: Legacy research may have partial provenance and must remain labeled legacy_provenance_partial.
Source authority is a deterministic ordering and does not imply lower-ranked sources are always incorrect.
methodologies.change_summary: Phase 2 canonical evidence provenance baseline completed on main.

methodologies.name: Canonical Fact Normalization V1
methodologies.purpose: Select and normalize point-in-time company facts deterministically from preserved source observations while keeping revisions, conflicts, derivations, and superseded facts auditable.

output_contract.normalized_facts: append-only canonical facts with economic/knowledge time

assumptions.same_provider_later_statement: revision rather than independent provider conflict

known_limitations: Canonical selection cannot create source evidence that was never observed.
Derived metrics remain dependent on the correctness and completeness of their input fact lineage.
methodologies.change_summary: Phase 2 canonical fact normalization baseline completed on main.

methodologies.name: Valuation V3
methodologies.purpose: Produce sector-aware bear/base/bull intrinsic-value ranges and horizon-specific expected returns from explicit assumptions without silent fallback inputs.

input_contract.valuation_inputs: explicit per-share metrics, assumptions, historical/peer anchors, evidence support

known_limitations: Requires reviewed explicit assumptions and relative-valuation anchors.
Fair value is model output, not a timing forecast.
methodologies.change_summary: Adds explicit sector-aware valuation engine with no silent fallback assumptions.

methodologies.name: Solpient 100 Universe Screening V1
methodologies.purpose: Screen a broad investable equity universe for companies that merit deeper Solpient research without treating the pre-research score as an investment decision.

input_contract.universe_row: normalized investability, quality, durability, balance sheet, growth and valuation fields

assumptions.missing_data: reduces evidence coverage; never mapped to neutral 50

known_limitations: Broad quantitative screen does not replace qualitative moat/management research.
Provider coverage can affect evidence completeness.
methodologies.change_summary: Adds provider-agnostic broad-universe research-funnel methodology.

methodologies.name: Research Candidate Pipeline V1
methodologies.purpose: Connect shortlisted Solpient 100 candidates to explicit Valuation V3 inputs and Readiness V1 gates without substituting screening scores for reviewed research.
known_limitations: A shortlisted company can remain blocked until reviewed V3 inputs exist.
Readiness quality scores come from reviewed research, never screening proxies.
methodologies.change_summary: Adds governed shortlist-to-valuation-to-readiness handoff.

methodologies.name: Solpient Universe Sector Model V2
methodologies.purpose: Classify the U.S. equity universe into economically distinct sectors and screening profiles so broad-universe evidence is evaluated with sector-appropriate accounting logic without forced sector quotas.

assumptions.financial_debt_treatment: generic corporate leverage rules are not applied to financial profiles
assumptions.reit_ffo_proxy: net income plus depreciation/amortization is screening-only and is not reviewed FFO/AFFO

known_limitations: SEC SIC is coarse and may not fully describe diversified business mixes.
Foreign/IFRS issuers without usable US-GAAP companyfacts can remain outside the SEC-first normalized universe.
Bank equity/assets does not replace CET1; insurer equity/assets does not replace statutory solvency/RBC review.
REIT FFO proxy is screening-only and does not replace reviewed NAREIT FFO or AFFO.
methodologies.change_summary: Replaces V1 catch-all Services and bank-like Financials treatment with deterministic sector/subsector classification and sector-appropriate SEC-derived screening fields.

methodologies.name: Solpient 100 Universe Screening V2
methodologies.purpose: Screen a broad investable equity universe for deep-research candidates using sector-aware evidence and valuation measures while keeping missing evidence explicit and preserving human review for Solpient 100 membership.

input_contract.universe_row: normalized investability, sector profile, quality, durability, balance sheet, growth and valuation fields

assumptions.missing_data: reduces evidence coverage; never mapped to neutral 50
assumptions.financial_valuation: trailing P/E and price/book for bank/insurance broad screening
assumptions.reit_valuation: screening FFO proxy is non-authoritative and must be replaced by reviewed FFO/AFFO in deep research

known_limitations: Broad quantitative screening does not replace qualitative moat, management or industry research.
SEC taxonomy and companyfacts coverage can still affect evidence completeness.
Financial capital/solvency and property FFO/AFFO require reviewed deep-research evidence before Decision Ready.
methodologies.change_summary: Adds sector-aware screening profiles for banks, insurance, asset managers, real estate/REITs, communication services, consumer staples/discretionary and technology while preserving V1 historical reproducibility.

methodologies.name: Research Candidate Pipeline V2
methodologies.purpose: Connect Sector Model V2 screening candidates to Valuation V3 and Readiness without silently applying generic corporate FCF valuation to financial or real-estate profiles that lack a reviewed industry-specific valuation module.

input_contract.screen_result: eligible Sector Model V2 shortlist company

output_contract.valuation_profile_gate: explicit industry-specific valuation support or blocker

assumptions.unsupported_sector_valuation: block rather than fall back to generic corporate FCF

known_limitations: Insurance, asset-manager/diversified-financial and real-estate/REIT candidates remain valuation-blocked until a reviewed Valuation V3 sector module or explicit reviewed override exists.
Readiness quality scores still come from reviewed research, never screening proxies.
methodologies.change_summary: Updates the shortlist handoff for Sector Model V2 and blocks unsupported generic-FCF valuation paths.

methodologies.name: Solpient Sector Evidence Model V2.1
methodologies.purpose: Separate broad quantitative screening merit from sector-specific evidence completeness by reserving explicit evidence weight for decision-critical bank, insurance, asset-management, financial and real-estate facts.

assumptions.missing_sector_evidence: reduces effective coverage rather than economic score

known_limitations: Sector-critical evidence is presence-based at this stage; later versions should incorporate source quality, recency and conflict state.
The reserved evidence percentages are calibration parameters that require full-universe validation before activation.
Critical field groups are broad research requirements and do not by themselves prove underwriting, credit, solvency or property quality.
methodologies.change_summary: Adds sector-specific evidence completeness, confidence ceilings, and an Unknown-classification promotion block after V2 full-universe validation showed overconfidence in financial-sector coverage.

methodologies.name: Solpient 100 Universe Screening V2.1
methodologies.purpose: Screen the broad investable universe using Sector Model V2 economic profiles while applying Sector Evidence Model V2.1 confidence ceilings so incomplete sector-critical evidence cannot masquerade as complete research coverage.

assumptions.missing_sector_evidence: caps evidence coverage, not economic score

known_limitations: Sector-sensitive candidates require additional reviewed evidence before Solpient 100 Candidate promotion.
Broad screening remains a research-funnel tool and does not replace qualitative moat, management or industry work.
Foreign/IFRS coverage remains limited by the SEC-first US-GAAP normalization path.
methodologies.change_summary: Calibrates V2 by separating raw technical coverage from sector-critical evidence completeness and blocking unresolved Unknown classifications from automated Solpient 100 Candidate promotion.

methodologies.name: Research Candidate Pipeline V2.1
methodologies.purpose: Carry Universe Screening V2.1 candidates into research, valuation and readiness while preserving sector-evidence blockers and preventing unsupported generic valuation fallbacks.

input_contract.screen_result: eligible V2.1 screen result with sector-evidence state

output_contract.valuation_profile_gate: explicit supported valuation module or blocker

known_limitations: Sector-specific evidence collection still requires provider/source expansion for many financial and real-estate metrics.
Insurance, asset-manager/diversified-financial and real-estate/REIT valuation remains blocked without reviewed sector-specific valuation support.
methodologies.change_summary: Advances the candidate pipeline to consume V2.1 evidence-adjusted screening results while preserving existing valuation safety gates.

methodologies.name: Solpient Sector Classification Repair V2.2
methodologies.purpose: Repair unresolved or economically misleading sector classifications through a deterministic hierarchy without destabilizing the broad Sector Model V2 taxonomy.

assumptions.hierarchy: issuer override -> targeted SIC repair -> description repair -> Sector Model V2 -> valid provider fallback -> unresolved

known_limitations: Issuer overrides require periodic review when business models or tickers materially change.
SEC SIC remains coarse and description rules are intentionally narrow.
Unresolved issuers remain Unknown rather than being guessed into a sector.
methodologies.change_summary: Repairs known Unknown/general classifications, adds reviewed issuer overrides, targeted SIC/description rules, and explicit classification audit metadata.

methodologies.name: Solpient 100 Universe Screening V2.2
methodologies.purpose: Apply Classification Repair V2.2 before V2.1 evidence-confidence screening so repaired sector profiles are evaluated with the correct economic and evidence model.

input_contract.universe_row: normalized broad-universe row including ticker/SIC metadata where available

known_limitations: Classification repair does not replace full qualitative industry review.
A small unresolved set may remain until a defensible issuer/SIC/description rule is reviewed.
methodologies.change_summary: Applies V2.2 classification repair at screen time while leaving V2.1 scoring thresholds and evidence ceilings unchanged.

methodologies.name: Research Candidate Pipeline V2.2
methodologies.purpose: Carry V2.2 classified candidates into valuation/readiness while preserving V2.1 sector-evidence blockers and unsupported-sector valuation safeguards.

output_contract.valuation_profile_gate: explicit supported valuation module or blocker

known_limitations: Sector-specific evidence collection is still required for financial and real-estate candidates.
Unsupported insurer/asset-manager/real-estate valuation remains blocked.
methodologies.change_summary: Advances the research-candidate handoff to consume V2.2 classification-repaired screen results.

methodologies.name: Solpient Sector Classification Coverage V2.3
methodologies.purpose: Eliminate obvious operating-company Unknown classifications while routing genuinely ambiguous or insufficient-data issuers to an explicit review queue rather than guessing a sector.

output_contract.sector: economic sector or Unknown only when review-required
output_contract.classification_review_required: true only for genuinely ambiguous or insufficient-data issuers

assumptions.hierarchy: reviewed issuer override -> reviewed issuer queue -> V2.2 classifier -> safe SIC/description coverage -> review_required

known_limitations: Some transitional or conglomerate business models still require human classification review.
Issuer overrides must be re-reviewed after material business-model changes, acquisitions, or divestitures.
Safe SIC-family coverage is intentionally conservative and does not attempt to emulate a complete commercial taxonomy.
methodologies.change_summary: Adds safe SIC-family coverage, current-economics issuer overrides, an explicit review_required state, and a zero-obvious-Unknown audit target.

methodologies.name: Solpient 100 Universe Screening V2.3
methodologies.purpose: Apply Sector Classification Coverage V2.3 before unchanged Sector Evidence V2.1 screening so obvious operating companies receive the correct profile and ambiguous names remain explicitly review-blocked.
known_limitations: Review-required names remain capped by the Unknown-classification evidence rule until a reviewed sector is assigned.
Classification coverage does not replace qualitative company research.
methodologies.change_summary: Advances screening to V2.3 taxonomy coverage while leaving V2.2 score mechanics and V2.1 evidence ceilings unchanged.

methodologies.name: Research Candidate Pipeline V2.3
methodologies.purpose: Carry V2.3 classification results into valuation/readiness and preserve explicit classification-review reasons as research repair actions.

output_contract.next_actions: ordered evidence, classification, valuation and readiness repair actions
output_contract.classification_review: specific review reason retained when sector assignment is ambiguous

known_limitations: Classification review remains a manual evidence task for mixed or transitional issuers.
Sector-specific valuation remains blocked where no reviewed Valuation V3 industry module exists.
methodologies.change_summary: Advances the research pipeline to V2.3 and preserves human-readable classification review reasons downstream.
